tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Eclipse Cargo Tracker is a Jakarta EE application demonstrating Domain-Driven Design. Start with the README and pom.xml to see the stack.

tour.title: Aggregates: Cargo
tour.description: The Cargo aggregate root holds a TrackingId, route specification, itinerary and delivery progress.

tour.title: Handling, Voyage and Location
tour.description: Handling events record what happens to cargo; voyages and locations describe the transport network.

tour.title: Repositories and Factories
tour.description: Domain-owned repository interfaces and factories decouple the model from persistence.

tour.title: Application Services
tour.description: Services orchestrate use cases: booking, inspecting cargo and registering handling events.

tour.title: Infrastructure: Persistence
tour.description: JPA repositories implement the domain repository interfaces.

tour.title: Infrastructure: Messaging and Events
tour.description: JMS consumers and application events decouple handling registration from cargo inspection.

tour.title: Pathfinder Routing
tour.description: A separate pathfinder service computes itineraries, reached via an external routing adapter.

tour.title: Handling Interfaces
tour.description: Handling reports arrive via REST, mobile, and batch file processing.

tour.title: Booking Web UI
tour.description: JSF backing beans, a DTO facade and assemblers serve the booking and tracking UI.

tour.title: Tests
tour.description: Unit tests cover domain behaviour; Arquillian config supports integration tests.
